topic: Blackbeard's unexplained raid on Drum Island was a hunt for Chopper's Human-Human Fruit, and chapter 1177's Monster Point reversal of Domi Reversi is the payoff
title: Blackbeard Raided Drum Island For Chopper (1177)
description:
Why did Blackbeard raid Drum Island before the Straw Hats ever arrived? In chapter 1177, Tony Tony Chopper's Monster Point punch reverses one of Imu's Domi Reversi demons without a lethal blow, and I think that points straight back to Drum Island and the Human-Human Fruit.

This is a theory built from Hiriluk's creed, Kureha's warning, the Rumble Ball and Blackbeard's habit of hunting fruits. Do you think Teach raided Drum for Chopper's fruit, or only for doctors and supplies?

comment: Did Blackbeard raid Drum Island for Chopper's fruit, or just for supplies and doctors to study his own body? Pick one.

lines.text: Why did Chopper's fist undo the one thing Imu's Domi Reversi was never supposed to let go of?

shot.fallback: shadowy ruler with glowing eyes turning warriors into demons

lines.text: And why did Blackbeard raid Chopper's home island years before anyone knew what that fruit could do?

shot.fallback: dark bearded pirate captain on a snowy island

lines.text: Here's my read, said flat: Drum Island was never a random stop on Blackbeard's route. It was a shopping trip.

shot.fallback: grinning pirate captain with missing teeth

lines.text: This is chapter 1177, titled Furious, and it quietly rewrites the oldest open question of the Drum Island arc.

shot.fallback: reindeer doctor standing before giants

lines.text: Eiichiro Oda never told us why five pirates sailed to a snowy kingdom and sent its king running.

shot.fallback: cowardly king running from a castle

lines.text: I think he told us in 1177, then looked away so nobody would notice.

shot.fallback: reindeer monster in a giant village

lines.text: But to see it, we have to start with a lonely reindeer in a blizzard, long before any of this...

shot.fallback: small blue nosed reindeer alone in a blizzard

lines.text: Start small. Chopper is born on Drum Island with a blue nose, and his own herd and parents treat him as an outcast.

shot.search: Chopper young reindeer blue nose herd
shot.fallback: young reindeer with a blue nose far behind a herd

lines.text: Then, at nine years old, he accidentally eats a fruit. The Human-Human Fruit.

shot.search: Chopper Hito Hito no Mi eating
shot.fallback: starving reindeer eating a strange mushroom shaped fruit

lines.text: It gives him a human mind, and with it the power to understand exactly how much everyone hates him.

shot.fallback: reindeer with a human expression looking sad

lines.text: The herd drives him out. The villagers mistake him for a Yeti and shoot at him.

shot.fallback: angry villagers with torches chasing a reindeer in snow

lines.text: This matters for my theory, so hold onto it: Chopper is a rumor on that island long before he's a doctor.

shot.fallback: villagers whispering in a snowy town

lines.text: A blue nosed reindeer that talks and walks upright is not a secret. That is a story people tell in every bar.

shot.fallback: reindeer standing upright like a person

lines.text: Chapters 141 and 142 give us the rescue. A blizzard, a hurt reindeer, and a wandering quack named Hiriluk.

shot.fallback: eccentric doctor with a pirate flag hat kneeling in snow beside a reindeer

lines.text: Hiriluk doesn't scare him with promises. He proves he's carrying nothing dangerous, and lets Chopper decide.

shot.fallback: man opening his coat in the snow to show he is unarmed

lines.text: That one gesture is the first time any human treats Chopper as a person instead of a problem.

shot.fallback: doctor and reindeer sharing a small cabin

lines.text: Hiriluk's creed, from chapter 142, is simple: there is no disease in the world that cannot be cured.

shot.search: Hiriluk creed no disease cannot be cured
shot.fallback: doctor pointing toward the sky with a determined grin

lines.text: Keep that sentence in your head, because it comes back in a very uncomfortable way.

shot.fallback: smiling quack doctor with a tall hat

lines.text: Chopper takes it as scripture. He studies medicine under a man whose own body is already failing.

shot.fallback: reindeer reading a thick medical book

lines.text: He also learns something sweeter from him: the Jolly Roger isn't a symbol of fear, it's a symbol of strength against all odds.

shot.fallback: doctor pointing at a skull flag proudly

lines.text: Chopper believes it so hard that he later spots a skull and crossbones in a medicine book and doesn't know what it means medically.

shot.fallback: reindeer puzzled by a skull in a book

lines.text: In chapters 143 and 144, Chopper goes off alone to find a medicine mushroom for him.

shot.fallback: reindeer carrying a colorful mushroom through snow

lines.text: He brings back an Amiudake, believing it will help. It's poison, and Hiriluk eats it anyway.

shot.fallback: doctor accepting a gift from a reindeer

lines.text: Chapter 145 is Wapol's trap and Hiriluk's final choice, and I won't pretend I can narrate that lightly.

shot.fallback: doctor standing in a stone castle hall

lines.text: What matters here is what he leaves behind: a belief, a flag, and a dream shaped like cherry blossoms.

shot.search: Hiriluk Jolly Roger flag Drum Castle
shot.fallback: pirate flag flying above a snowy castle

lines.text: Dr. Kureha takes over Chopper's training. Per the wiki, five years of research went into one drug, the Rumble Ball.

shot.fallback: old woman doctor teaching a reindeer

lines.text: Then in chapters 153 and 154, she fires Hiriluk's cherry blossom powder into the sky and Drum Island turns pink.

shot.search: Hiriluk cherry blossoms Drum Island snow
shot.fallback: pink petals falling over a snowy kingdom

lines.text: Chopper leaves with the Straw Hats right after. A kingdom that hated him sends him off in flowers.

shot.search: Chopper joins Straw Hats Drum Island
shot.fallback: reindeer waving from a pirate ship leaving a snowy island

lines.text: So here's the first thing most fans forget: that fruit made Chopper hated long before it made him strong.

shot.search: Chopper outcast Hito Hito no Mi
shot.fallback: lonely reindeer in the snow

lines.text: And a hated fruit eater is exactly the kind of lead a man like Blackbeard follows...

shot.fallback: pirate captain staring at a glowing fruit

lines.text: Now to the raid. The Blackbeard Pirates are the unseen antagonists of the Drum Island arc.

shot.fallback: silhouetted pirate crew on a snowy shore

lines.text: At that point Teach has only five crew members. Five. And they hit a kingdom with a castle and a king.

shot.search: Blackbeard Pirates five members early crew
shot.fallback: five pirates walking through snow

lines.text: By the wiki's account, the attack is so overwhelming that King Wapol runs without even trying to fight.

shot.fallback: king fleeing his own castle

lines.text: Wapol, a man who cared about nothing except his own appetite, abandons his throne and his castle.

shot.fallback: greedy king with a huge appetite

lines.text: Wapol will return later and be beaten by Luffy, and Dalton ends up elected king, so the throne stays empty for a stretch.

shot.search: Luffy Wapol Drum Island Dalton king
shot.fallback: straw hat boy punching a greedy king

lines.text: That gap is the window where Blackbeard could have taken a kingdom for free. He doesn't even try.

shot.fallback: empty throne room in a snowy castle

lines.text: Here's the detail that bothers me. Blackbeard doesn't take the crown. He doesn't claim the kingdom.

shot.fallback: pirate captain beside an empty throne

lines.text: He just leaves. Ace chases him there later, arrives after the crew is gone, and moves on toward Arabasta.

shot.search: Ace Drum Island Blackbeard Nanohana message
shot.fallback: fire user pirate on a snowy island

lines.text: So Teach sails in, makes a king run, and leaves. Why would a man with five crew spend time on a snowy island?

shot.fallback: pirate captain looking at a snowy mountain

lines.text: Oda has never explained it. No dialogue, no flashback, no motive. That silence is not an accident.

shot.fallback: tall snowy mountain with a castle on top

lines.text: Fans have floated the usual answers: a supply stop, a search for doctors, or a hunt for the Nika fruit.

shot.search: Blackbeard Pirates Devil Fruit Nika search
shot.fallback: pirate looking at old maps

lines.text: Let me take the doctor theory seriously, because it's the strongest of the old ones.

shot.fallback: pirate beside a doctor's bag

lines.text: Blackbeard carries two Devil Fruit powers, Dark-Dark and Tremor-Tremor, and Oda has never explained how his body survives both.

shot.fallback: pirate captain with dark aura and a shaking fist

lines.text: A man like that might want the best medical minds alive to tell him what he is.

shot.fallback: pirate captain looking at his own hands

lines.text: Drum Island had that reputation, until Wapol's rule drove nearly every doctor away. Only Kureha and Hiriluk stayed free.

shot.fallback: old woman doctor on a mountain

lines.text: But look at what the doctor theory and a fruit theory have in common. Both want something that can heal or fix a body.

shot.search: Hito Hito no Mi Chopper human form
shot.fallback: reindeer doctor holding medicine

lines.text: And the one thing on that island that fits both is a blue nosed reindeer with a fruit nobody understood.

shot.search: Chopper Hito Hito no Mi Heavy Point
shot.fallback: reindeer doctor in a determined pose

lines.text: Before I can prove that, I need to show you what Chopper built to hide his power from his own teacher.

shot.fallback: reindeer holding a glowing pill

lines.text: Because the Rumble Ball started as a secret, and what exactly did he swallow that day?

shot.fallback: reindeer swallowing a strange pill in a lab

lines.text: The Rumble Ball starts as a cover up. Young Chopper borrows rare medicines from Kureha's shelves to experiment.

shot.fallback: young reindeer sneaking into a medicine cabinet

lines.text: Afraid of getting caught, he mixes them all together and swallows the result. That accident becomes his signature drug.

shot.fallback: reindeer mixing colorful medicines

lines.text: Perfecting it takes him five years of research, which is nearly his whole apprenticeship under Kureha.

shot.search: Rumble Ball Chopper Kureha five years
shot.fallback: old doctor and a reindeer at a lab table

lines.text: The rules are simple. One ball opens his forms for three minutes. Three balls open Monster Point.

shot.search: Chopper Rumble Ball three minutes forms
shot.fallback: reindeer swallowing three glowing pills

lines.text: Monster Point is a giant, berserk body that cannot tell friend from enemy.

shot.fallback: huge furry monster roaring

lines.text: Kureha sees it once and forbids him from ever using it again.

shot.fallback: stern old woman pointing at a reindeer

lines.text: In the backstory, his first Monster Point rampage nearly destroys an entire village and his own body.

shot.fallback: huge furry beast in a snowy village

lines.text: That is why the ban exists. But a ban like that tells me she understood the fruit better than the boy did.

shot.fallback: old doctor studying a medical chart

lines.text: Most fans read that as a doctor protecting a kid from a dangerous drug. I think there's a second reading.

shot.fallback: old doctor looking worried at a reindeer

lines.text: Monster Point isn't just a Rumble Ball side effect. The ball only opens a door the fruit already built.

shot.search: Chopper Rumble Ball Monster Point fruit
shot.fallback: pill opening a glowing door inside a body

lines.text: The first time we see it on the page is Enies Lobby, where Chopper swallows three balls to face Kumadori and save Robin.

shot.search: Chopper Monster Point Kumadori Enies Lobby
shot.fallback: huge reindeer monster facing a painted warrior

lines.text: It's loud, wild, and out of control, exactly what Kureha was afraid of. For years we filed it under overdose.

shot.search: Chopper Monster Point Enies Lobby rampage
shot.fallback: furry monster roaring in a fortress

lines.text: A dangerous power up. A gimmick. Something he'd learn to control and then move on from.

shot.fallback: reindeer monster calming down

lines.text: Since the timeskip he changes forms freely, except Monster Point, which still needs a Rumble Ball. He reaches for one in Elbaph.

shot.fallback: reindeer swallowing a glowing ball in a giant village

lines.text: Then 1177. Chopper eats a Rumble Ball, becomes Monster Point, and punches a giant who has been turned into a demon.

shot.search: Chopper Monster Point Kashii giant demon
shot.fallback: monster reindeer protecting a giant boy

lines.text: On the wiki's Akuma no Mi page, a lethal blow can revert a demon, and that blow also restores the victim.

shot.fallback: demonized giant shown beside a black doorway

lines.text: Think about how strange that is for a rule Oda just wrote down.

shot.fallback: dark ruler flipping a hand

lines.text: Chopper never lands a lethal blow. The punch does no physical damage, and the demon just leaves.

shot.search: Chopper Monster Point punch no damage
shot.fallback: monster fist touching a giant's face

lines.text: So either Oda wrote a rule and Chopper broke it, or that fist isn't a punch at all. It's a treatment.

shot.fallback: reindeer doctor holding a glowing hand

lines.text: Here's my argument. Monster Point doesn't hit the sickness. It drags the human back to the surface.

shot.search: Chopper Hito Hito no Mi human restored
shot.fallback: glowing human silhouette rising from darkness

lines.text: Now go back to Hiriluk's creed from chapter 142: there is no disease in the world that cannot be cured.

shot.fallback: quack doctor smiling with raised finger

lines.text: Imu just built the biggest disease in the world, and Hiriluk's student is the first one who cures it.

shot.fallback: shadowy ruler glaring at a reindeer doctor

lines.text: Domi Reversi is simple and cruel: two demons stand on either side of a target, and the target becomes a demon too.

shot.fallback: game board pieces flipping from white to black

lines.text: Every warrior who falls to it loses their will. The only known reversal so far is a lethal blow.

shot.fallback: giants with glowing demon eyes

lines.text: Chopper is the first person to offer a third option, and that is the sort of detail that makes villains nervous.

shot.fallback: reindeer doctor standing before a dark throne

lines.text: Oda doesn't leave symmetry like that lying around. A man chases an impossible cure for thirty years, then leaves a son who finds one.

shot.search: Hiriluk cherry blossom research thirty years
shot.fallback: pink blossoms falling around a doctor's flag

lines.text: But if the fruit is the cure, who else figured that out before Chopper did?

shot.search: Blackbeard Chopper Hito Hito no Mi
shot.fallback: dark pirate captain staring at a reindeer silhouette

lines.text: So let me build the case the way a detective would, from Teach's habits instead of Chopper's power.

shot.fallback: pirate captain with a magnifying glass

lines.text: Look at Blackbeard's own pattern. Every big move Teach makes is about a Devil Fruit.

shot.search: Marshall D. Teach Devil Fruit collector
shot.fallback: pirate holding a glowing fruit

lines.text: He turns on a division commander on Whitebeard's ship to take the Dark-Dark Fruit, the one that cancels other fruits' powers.

shot.search: Blackbeard Thatch Yami Yami no Mi
shot.fallback: pirate betraying a cook on a ship

lines.text: At Marineford, he takes Whitebeard's Tremor-Tremor Fruit for himself, and nobody understands how he can hold both.

shot.search: Blackbeard Gura Gura no Mi Marineford
shot.fallback: pirate with a cracking dark aura

lines.text: A man who builds a crew around fruits doesn't wander into a random island. He follows a lead.

shot.fallback: pirate captain studying a map

lines.text: And what was the lead? A fruit that gave an animal a human mind.

shot.search: Hito Hito no Mi Chopper Zoan
shot.fallback: fruit with a human face pattern

lines.text: To the world, a Zoan like that sounds like a pet trick. That's the cover, and Oda has done this exact trick before.

shot.search: Luffy Gomu Gomu no Mi Hito Hito no Mi Model Nika
shot.fallback: rubber fruit hiding a glowing sun god fruit

lines.text: Think about how the Hito Hito family is written. Models get names, and the names are the clue.

shot.search: Hito Hito no Mi Model Daibutsu Nika list
shot.fallback: legendary figures on stone tablets

lines.text: Luffy's fruit hid under the name Gomu Gomu, but it was a Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika all along.

shot.search: Luffy Gear 5 Hito Hito no Mi Model Nika
shot.fallback: laughing white haired sun god

lines.text: Sengoku's fruit is the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Daibutsu. Chopper's is the one in that family whose model has never been named.

shot.search: Sengoku Hito Hito no Mi Model Daibutsu
shot.fallback: giant golden Buddha form

lines.text: I can't prove Teach knew that. But I can prove how he works: rumors first, fruits second.

shot.fallback: pirate captain listening to a whispering informant

lines.text: And a talking reindeer chased off by villagers is a rumor worth following.

shot.search: Chopper Drum Island rumor Kureha mountain
shot.fallback: reindeer in front of a snowy mountain castle

lines.text: Here's the detail most of us skip. Before Wapol fled, Kureha lived on the outskirts of Gyasta, not in the castle.

shot.fallback: old woman's small house at the edge of a snowy village

lines.text: She only moves into Drum Castle after Wapol is gone and the throne is empty.

shot.fallback: old woman entering a grand snowy castle

lines.text: So Teach hits the castle, finds a king who bolts, and finds none of the people who would have mattered.

shot.fallback: pirate crew inside an empty castle

lines.text: Notice who was living somewhere else on that island. A doctor and her blue nosed apprentice.

shot.fallback: old woman and a young reindeer at a window

lines.text: He leaves empty handed because what he came for lived somewhere else on the island.

shot.fallback: pirate ship sailing away from a snowy coast

lines.text: And a pirate that clever doesn't forget a place like that. He just waits until the thing on the island becomes a name...

shot.fallback: dark pirate captain watching a distant ship

lines.text: Now let me argue against myself, because that is where these theories usually fall apart.

shot.fallback: two figures arguing

lines.text: Okay, the best counter argument. Teach had five crew and a ship to feed, and a weak kingdom is an easy stop.

shot.fallback: pirate ship at a snowy dock

lines.text: Pirates raid weak kingdoms all the time. Wapol was a selfish king, and that kingdom was an easy target.

shot.fallback: king beside rows of soldiers

lines.text: And the sharpest objection: how could Blackbeard know about a reindeer at all?

shot.fallback: pirate captain with a puzzled grin

lines.text: Nothing on the pages I checked says the Blackbeard Pirates ever heard his name.

shot.fallback: reindeer hidden in snow

lines.text: That's true. I can't hand you a panel that closes the case. Anyone who says otherwise is selling you something.

shot.fallback: reindeer doctor and a question mark

lines.text: But the objection quietly assumes Teach needed to know the fruit's power. He didn't. He only needed the rumor.

shot.fallback: pirate hearing a whispered tale

lines.text: The villagers were hunting Chopper in chapter 141. That kind of story travels.

shot.fallback: villagers chasing a reindeer in the snow

lines.text: Second, a supply stop doesn't explain why he left Wapol on the run and didn't even keep the kingdom.

shot.fallback: pirate crew departing

lines.text: Ace arrives after Blackbeard has already left, and he is chasing Blackbeard, not Wapol.

shot.fallback: fire user pirate on a snowy road

lines.text: People who raid for supplies take what's there. Blackbeard takes only what's rare.

shot.fallback: pirate holding a single glowing fruit

lines.text: And third, the 1177 reversal is real, on the page, in chapter 1177. A fruit that cures a curse is not a coincidence.

shot.search: Chopper Monster Point cured demon Chapter 1177
shot.fallback: monster reindeer next to a restored giant

lines.text: I'd call my reading better than even, not certain. That's the honest number I'd put on it.

shot.fallback: reindeer and a dark figure facing each other

lines.text: But all of this depends on one piece of the story I haven't touched yet: what Chopper became when the crew was scattered...

shot.fallback: pirates flying apart from a bear paw blast

lines.text: After Sabaody, the Straw Hats are split up for two years.

shot.fallback: bear shaped man sending pirates through the air

lines.text: Zoro lands on Kuraigana Island, where Mihawk and Perona already live.

shot.fallback: gothic castle on a foggy island

lines.text: Mihawk agrees to train Zoro. That's two years of the best swordsman alive teaching a student how to cut.

shot.fallback: swordsman master and green haired student training

lines.text: Chopper's island is the opposite. He lands in Torino Kingdom, where the locals want to cook him.

shot.fallback: reindeer surrounded by curious villagers on a tropical island

lines.text: No master. No swords. A library. He uses it to research and perfect his transformations.

shot.fallback: reindeer reading in a quiet library

lines.text: When he comes back, he can reach his forms without taking the drug, including new ones like Kung Fu Point.

shot.fallback: reindeer in martial arts pose

lines.text: Mihawk's island gave the crew its blade. Torino gave it a medic who stopped needing his own crutch.

shot.fallback: swordsman and reindeer side by side

lines.text: Think about what that means for Kureha. She trained a boy who would later outgrow every lesson she gave him.

shot.fallback: old doctor smiling as a reindeer leaves

lines.text: Now look at Elbaph. Zoro is at the Western Village with the giants, holding the line against the demonized.

shot.fallback: swordsman in a giant village

lines.text: A sword can only do one thing to a demon. It can stop it. Only Chopper's punch brought one back.

shot.fallback: swordsman and a reindeer monster side by side

lines.text: Zoro cuts through the demonized giants with ease. Chopper punches one and it gets its life back.

shot.fallback: swordsman beside a doctor reindeer in a giant village

lines.text: That's the Straw Hat division of labor Oda keeps building toward: the blade that holds, and the hand that heals.

shot.fallback: pirate crew with a swordsman and a doctor

lines.text: And Imu knows what's coming, because he has never been afraid of a sword he can regenerate through...

shot.fallback: dark ruler staring across a world map

lines.text: So what does my theory predict? If Chopper's fruit is the answer to Domi Reversi, the story has to show someone noticing.

shot.fallback: reindeer doctor looking up at a dark sky

lines.text: The first person who should notice is Gaban, who lay hurt next to Chopper in the very chapter where he did it.

shot.fallback: old swordsman resting next to a reindeer

lines.text: Gaban was lying hurt beside Chopper when that punch landed. He was right there to see it.

shot.fallback: old swordsman from the Roger Pirates

lines.text: The second should be Blackbeard, wherever he is, because he's the one man who has been circling this answer for years.

shot.fallback: pirate captain looking at a distant island

lines.text: And the third is the one nobody talks about: Kureha, who forbade Monster Point because she saw what it really was.

shot.fallback: old doctor looking at a huge furry monster

lines.text: If I'm wrong, Chopper is just a strong doctor, and Oda wrote a rule and let a gimmick break it. I don't buy that.

shot.fallback: reindeer doctor looking uncertain

lines.text: If I'm right, Drum Island was never a footnote. It was the first move in a game about who gets to own the cure.

shot.search: Drum Island arc Blackbeard first move
shot.fallback: snowy island on a chessboard

lines.text: Think about what Imu has to do next. He can't ignore a doctor who can reverse the one move that makes his army.

shot.fallback: shadowy ruler beside rows of demons

lines.text: Chopper started as a monster nobody would touch. He might end as the one thing Imu's monsters can't survive.

shot.fallback: small reindeer standing before giants

lines.text: Blackbeard didn't visit Drum Island to loot a kingdom. He went there to find the cure that didn't exist yet.

shot.search: Blackbeard Chopper Hito Hito no Mi
shot.fallback: dark pirate silhouette behind a reindeer

lines.text: And if you want to see how Blackbeard really behaved at Marineford, that's the video you watch next.
